extracted.name: Easy Small-Batch Blueberry Jam
extracted.description: This blueberry jam recipe uses just 4 ingredients and no pectin to make a homemade jam that’s sweet and spreadable with lots of blueberry flavor.
instruction_lines: Mix blueberries, sugar, lemon juice, and cinnamon in a saucepan.
Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat until thickened, about 30 minutes.
Remove from the heat and let the jam cool completely. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate until chilled and set. Enjoy!
